name: Ultrasonic Waves
doc: Ultrasonic Waves (Red Bat's attack): the root and the controller - the waves, the rings flying to the target, the three bursts at the target, the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag152_ultrasonic_waves.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools in the module, its packets in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Controller
parts.doc: The waves, the rings flying to the target, the three bursts at the target, the sound; the damage

params.doc: The damage at this tick of the controller
